content: CockroachDB HLC lessons (Living Without Atomic Clocks): unsynchronized clocks cause causal-reverse anomaly (later transaction commits with earlier timestamp on disjoint keys); NTP typical offset 100-250ms vs Spanner TrueTime 7ms; CockroachDB uses uncertainty intervals and restarts reads instead of waiting on writes; nodes exceeding configured max-offset (default 500ms) self-terminate rather than trust bad clocks; monotonic wall clock per node is assumed (single-node monotonicity), enforced via clock monitoring. For sup-kv: a node clock-jumped far ahead will deterministically win all conflicts until real time catches up - drift_warn metric is the only defense; document that LWW winner under skew is arbitrary-but-deterministic.
